original.text: caṇḍālo 'stu sa tu dvijo 'stu gurur ity eṣā manīṣā mama
original.edition: vulgate wording recalled from memory (verify against an edition)

paraphrase: Whoever has firmly realized that the one consciousness shines in waking, dream and deep sleep and pervades all beings from Brahmā to the ant — whether he be an outcaste or a twice-born — he is my guru: this is my conviction.
notes: The original gives only the refrain. Attributed to Śaṅkara (traditional).
